Halo Legnica.

Agencja Aktorska Edwin Film poszukuje statystów z Legnicy i okolic do serialu fabularnego, osadzonego w Polsce w latach 90. 

Dołącz do projektu z gwiazdorską obsadą na jedną z platform streamingowych.

Miejsce zdjęć: Legnica

Terminy zdjęć: 18-27.09. 

(Prosimy o dostępność na cały dzień.)

Szukamy statystów w każdym wieku: zapraszamy dzieci od 8 roku życia, młodzież, studentów, osoby aktywne zawodowo ale i też te niepracujące, mile widziani emeryci i renciści.
Każdy może zaistnieć na planie filmowym.

📩 Jak wysłać zgłoszenie:

Prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia drogą mailową na iga.edwinfilm@gmail.com lub SMS na numer 733 907 497 zawierającego informacje:

Imię i nazwisko

Numer telefonu

Wiek

Wzrost

Wyraźne zdjęcia.

Miejsce zamieszkania.

oraz dyspozycyjność w wymienionych terminach.

W tytule maila wpisz hasło "Legnica."

Prosimy o nie wysyłanie informacji na priv i nie zgłaszanie się pod postem.

Zapraszamy.

Poszukuję Modeli i Modelek do sesji zdjęciowej dla firmy kurierskiej. 📦

Kogo?: 

-Kobiet i Mężczyzn w wieku 20-30lat, którzy czują się swobodnie przed aparatem, potrafią się uśmiechać do obiektywu i mają doświadczenie w sesjach foto.

items.text:
Missed out on the Edinburgh Fringe this year? Or already desperate for another go? Then we have an opportunity for you!

We’re Such People Productions, a theatre company founded by poet and playwright Nadia Lines in 2024. 

We’re headed to Edinburgh Fringe in the summer of 2027 with our show The Book of Margery Kempe, and we need a producer to help make it happen!

In this fast-paced, time travelling retelling of the autobiography of one of the
Middle Age’s most incredible women, real-life medieval mystic Margery Kempe takes to the stage to give us her life in her own words – tears and all.

For fans of y2k medievalism, women’s history, and sacrilege, The Book of Margery Kempe is already a sold-out, five star, award-winning production. You can find out all about the play, and our company, below - or find us on Instagram @suchpeople.productions 

All of the information you need to apply to be our producer is the google doc linked in this post. Or, if you're looking for a more low commitment way of getting involved, then you can sign up to be a Friend of Margery.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 

https://linktr.ee/thebookofmargerykempe

URGENT : recherche très belle femme BCBG/Hyper luxe BLONDE entre 55 et 70 ans( âge apparent )pour demain MERCREDI 09 SEPTEMBRE, à CASSIS. 
( priorité aux comédiennes, pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche une très belle femme blonde, type milliardaire issue de la jet set de St-Tropez, entre 55 et 70 ans( âge apparent )pour incarner les rares invités d’un déjeuner d’anniversaire très sélect.

Tournage ce MERCREDI 09 SEPTEMBRE à CASSIS( 13 ): 
Horaires prévisionnels : 11h30/22h30

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 09 et le 11 SEPTEMBRE.

Pour tous : il est impératif d’être autonomes pour se rendre sur le décor( et en repartir ).
Pas de défraiement transport de prévu, je cherche des personnes vivant à proximité de CASSIS( ou souhaitant venir à leurs frais, ou en covoiturage 🙂 ).

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts + éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a

Il n’y a pas d’autres dates prévues dans le SUD merci donc de ne pas postuler si vous n’êtes pas disponibles sur cette période. 

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  ANNIVERSAIRE 09 SEPTEMBRE BLONDE Chantal MARTINEZ 65 ans, 1m75, 60kg » etc, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre si possible les éléments suivants :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 09 et le 11 SEPTEMBRE 
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( ex policier par exemple etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

**CASTING CALL: LEAD ROLE**

 

We are casting the lead role of Carmelita Torres for CARMELITA, a historical short film based on true events, shooting in the Dallas/Fort Worth Area.

 

• **Union Status:** SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget

• **Location:** Dallas–Fort Worth area

• **Rate:** $250 per shoot day, plus meals, screen credit and a digital copy of the film

• **Shoot dates:** November 7, November 11–14 and December 4–5, 2026

• **Age:** Actress, age 18–24, who can convincingly play 17. Underage actors will not be considered.
• **Language:** Must be bilingual and speak fluent Spanish with a Mexican accent
• **Travel and lodging:** provided for the actress cast as CARMELITA

 

**TO SUBMIT:**

 

Email your full name, city, phone number, headshot and résumé, if available, to:

 

[SUBMIT.MIRANDACASTING@GMAIL.COM](mailto:SUBMIT.MIRANDACASTING@GMAIL.COM)

Subject: CARMELITA – Full Name – City

 

Actors with Casting Networks or Actors Access profiles may include a link. **Please do not submit through Facebook Messenger.**

Please share with anyone who may be a good fit!

Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

items.summary:
Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

Na plan filmu historycznego osadzonego w XIX wieku

PRZYMIARKI: 09.09 – Mokotów

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA MAILOWO:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

TYTUŁ MAILA: POWIŚLE

W treści zgłoszenia proszę podać:

- imię i nazwisko,
- wiek,
- wzrost,
- numer telefonu,
- informację o posiadanych tatuażach,
- informację o aparacie ortodontycznym.

📸 Koniecznie aktualne zdjęcia:

- twarzy,
- całej sylwetki,
- fryzury z boku,
- fryzury od tyłu.

Jesteś aktorem lub modelem i szukasz nowych projektów? A może po prostu szukasz sposobu na dodatkowy zarobek? Możesz zarabiać na własnym wizerunku, nie wychodząc z domu.

Ruszamy z AlterCast – platformą, która pozwala stworzyć Twojego cyfrowego "bliźniaka" do reklam. Zapraszamy profesjonalistów, ale szukamy też osób o każdym typie urody (nie musisz mieć doświadczenia przed kamerą).

Zasady są proste i w 100% bezpieczne:
* **Pełna kontrola:** sam decydujesz, w jakich branżach i projektach się pojawisz, a w jakich nie.
* **Pieniądze za każde użycie:** otrzymujesz **od 1000 PLN** za każdym razem, gdy marka wykupuje licencję na Twój wizerunek.
* **Pełna legalność:** umowa chroni twój wizerunek i odpowiada przepisom prawa.

# [NYC Casting for Indie Feature Comedy - Unpaid]
## A game of Dungeons & Dragons brings a friend group to the brink of destruction ON One hot night in Brooklyn.
* **ROLE**: Lead role, non-union, Light romance (on-screen kiss, no nudity). See description at the bottom of this post
* **CASTING**: 28-33yo, Nonbinary (they/them or they/she), all ethnicities. Audition will consist of a virtual interview. Callbacks will be a second-round virtual interview after talent has had the opportunity to read relevant scenes. No self-tape required.
* **COMPENSATION**: Unpaid; Meals & local travel covered. Seeking a run in the festival circuit and will be collectively owned & profit-share if successful there. 
* **REHEARSAL**: Sept 14th, 21st & 22nd, all virtual.
* **SHOOT DATES** (10d): 9/29>10/4, 10/6>10/9. Actors must be available all days. Days are limited to 10 hrs max.
* **LOCATION**: Brooklyn Heights (2/3 & 4/5 Trains, Nostrand LIRR). The whole film happens in one house, plus 1 day in Bronx (also 2/5/6 train). Talent must live in the NYC tri-state area and provide their own accommodations in NYC.
* **CONTACT**: Submit to **PunkRockFilmClub@gmail.com **
Please include as many as possible: your Reel, Resume, Social handles/Website, Headshot, phone, and email.  Please **do not message me directly**; I'm just posting on behalf of my director. 

[MEG (THEY/THEM, OR THEY/SHE)] Nonbinary; 28 to 33 years old; all ethnicities. Self-expressive, a little socially messy, heavy drinking, here to have a rowdy-good time. Hiding their relationship from their friend group; **must be comfortable kissing on camera. No nudity. There is an intimacy coordinator provided.** Requires FX makeup: edible fake blood. Stunts: Slow-motion grappling. Destruction of props (guitar, dice, pencils), Foam axe, wooden swords (brandished, not used to hit). Requires on-screen smoking: Inhalation of herbal cigarette. Familiarity with dungeons & dragons or roleplaying games is helpful, but not required.

PAID Position in Los Angeles. LA Locals Only 

Hello. I'm directing a micro budget feature film in March and I'm currently looking to cast some of the smaller supporting roles. All these roles are paid but its somewhat low pay which I apologize for that, I'm self financing this film myself 

Each role pays $200/day and will be needed on set anywhere between 4-9 days depending on the role.

Jennifer: Female. Age 40-50

Race: Any

Jennifer is health and wellness guru, she is a vegan, and believes in holistic medicine. She's in her 40s, not married. Lives alone

Rate: 200/day

Noah: Male. Age 25 - 35

Race: Black / African Descent, Ethnically Ambiguous / Multiracial

Noah is Mara's gay best friend who is an event planner. He is enthusiastic, sassy, but very caring. Always looking out for Mara's best interest.

Rate: 200/day

Luke: Male. Age 25-35

Race: White, Asian, Hispanic 

Noah's boyfriend, also became a friend of Mara's through Noah. He's a positive figure, has good vibes and is always down for a party

Rate: 200/day

Yakob Kessler: Male. Age 40-50

Race: Middle Eastern, Jewish, Eastern European 

Yakob Kessler is an Orthodox Jew who is also a gangster and one of Joel's main clients that he works with in the drug trade. He's very intelligent but is also ruthless

Rate: 200/day

Note for this role, the character must have an orthodox jewish accent. 

If you are interested, please send me a DM and mention what role you are submitting for. If you have any acting reels or work samples, that would be ideal as well. Thank you.

Project: DAS NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)
Format: Short Film / Music Video
Tone: Atmospheric Dark Folklore / Gothic Metal Thriller
Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 3 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th, 29th, and 31st

Project: DAS NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)
Format: Short Film / Music Video
Tone: Atmospheric Dark Folklore / Gothic Metal Thriller
Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.

**Title: ACTS OF MERCY**

**Genre: ***Drama*

**Logline: **Following the death of her mother, a veterinarian faces addiction and guilt as she tries to evade grief.

**Roles:**

**MAGNOLIA **- *LEAD - Female, 20-35*

Magnolia is no stranger to death, running an in-home animal hospital, yet refuses to grieve the death of her mother. She faces guilt, addiction, and drug induced hallucinations, but continually tries to bury her feelings.

**MARIE **- *SUPPORTING - Female, 40-60*

Marie is eccentric, confident in her decisions, and unafraid to grieve. She knows that euthanizing her cat will prevent it from suffering longer, but that doesn't lessen the impact of loss. She feels no embarrassment when expressing her grief.

**Director**: Evangeline Buchenberger

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**:

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 10am-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "ACTS OF MERCY CASTING - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will send you sides to send in as a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 14th, 16-19th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to drug use, self harm, and euthanasia.

Title: Sugarwater
Genre: Sci-fi/horror, student short film
Logline: Two construction workers uncover a strange creature in the dirt.

Characters:

Cam (M, 20s-30s, LEAD): 
An enamored construction worker with his head in the clouds.

Riley (M, 20s-30s, LEAD):
A sensible worker just trying to get through the day.

TV Woman (F, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
An old-Hollywood starlet radiating glamor.

TV Man (M, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
A classic noir antihero with a tendency to break hearts.

Shooting will take place over 4 days in November for Cam and Riley, and one day in October for the TV Woman and TV Man, all in or around the Denver, CO area. Compensation will be meals, gas compensation, credit, and a copy of the final film. The final film will be exhibited at CU Denver's Cinefest in May 2027 and will then be submitted to other film festivals for further distribution.

Use this link or scan the QR code in the flyer below to access to audition form: https://forms.gle/v9PMj5nAh4wV7fpA8

If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at caitlin.lebakken@cuanschutz.edu. Thank you!

AKTOR/SZUKAM PROJEKTÓW
Hej! Mam na imię Dominik Kusajda, mam 18 lat i szukam możliwości udziału w filmach, serialach, reklamach, teledyskach oraz innych produkcjach.

🎭 Od października rozpoczynam naukę w studium aktorskim i intensywnie rozwijam się w kierunku aktorstwa. Mam doświadczenie przed kamerą, m.in.:

• „Uroczysko” – epizod

• „Policjanci i Policjantki” – epizod

• „Trudne Sprawy” – rola drugoplanowa

• „Sprawiedliwi – Trójmiasto”

Przez 4 lata aktywnie interesowałem się również modelingiem i brałem udział m.in. w „Top Model”.

Dodatkowo umiem strzelać z łuku, co może być przydatną umiejętnością przy odpowiednich rolach i produkcjach.

Jestem otwarty na różnego rodzaju role i produkcje. Zależy mi przede wszystkim na zdobywaniu doświadczenia, pracy na planie i rozwijaniu się jako aktor

items.text:
CASTING CALL: CAN YOU PLAY A YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL?

We’re looking for someone with attitude. Opinions. Confidence. And preferably no shortage of any of them.

 

For more than 20 years, filmmaker Georgia Court has been documenting the extraordinary lives and work of Alfred Hinkel and John Linden. Now, as the documentary moves towards completion, several moments from their younger years are being brought back to life through dramatic re-enactments.

YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL

Young Alfred is opinionated, arrogant, charismatic, uncompromising and absolutely convinced he knows what he’s doing — even when everyone around him might have a different opinion.

Sound like someone you could play?

The film travels through Alfred’s younger years — from hitchhiking into O’Kiep, teaching his first dance classes in the 1970s and driving around in his Volksie, to the early days of Jazzart, the streets and dance culture of 1980s Cape Town, and eventually walking into CAPAB in the 1990s.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The actor must:

• Hold a valid driver’s licence and be comfortable driving for filming

• Be comfortable portraying a gay man — there are no overly affectionate scenes

• Be comfortable acting with a cigarette and portraying Alfred as a smoker

• Be available for rehearsals and filming in O’Kiep and Cape Town

items.summary:
CASTING CALL: CAN YOU PLAY A YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL?

We’re looking for someone with attitude. Opinions. Confidence. And preferably no shortage of any of them.

 

For more than 20 years, filmmaker Georgia Court has been documenting the extraordinary lives and work of Alfred Hinkel and John Linden. Now, as the documentary moves towards completion, several moments from their younger years are being brought back to life through dramatic re-enactments.

YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL

Young Alfred is opinionated, arrogant, charismatic, uncompromising and absolutely convinced he knows what he’s doing — even when everyone around him might have a different opinion.

Sound like someone you could play?

The film travels through Alfred’s younger years — from hitchhiking into O’Kiep, teaching his first dance classes in the 1970s and driving around in his Volksie, to the early days of Jazzart, the streets and dance culture of 1980s Cape Town, and eventually walking into CAPAB in the 1990s.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The actor must:

• Hold a valid driver’s licence and be comfortable driving for filming

• Be comfortable portraying a gay man — there are no overly affectionate scenes

• Be comfortable acting with a cigarette and portraying Alfred as a smoker

• Be available for rehearsals and filming in O’Kiep and Cape Town

 

OPEN CASTING CALL

Applicants must submit:

• Headshot

• Date of birth

• Height

• Clothing sizes

• City/Town of residence

Send your application to: info@georgiacourt.co.za

 

 

 

PROPOSED SCHEDULE (TBC)

September: Cape Town auditions – one day within this period, date TBC

Mid - Late October: Rehearsals & Shooting in Northern Cape & Cape Town 

 

THE SEARCH FOR YOUNG ALFRED IS ON!

Hey, ich bin Kerem, 18 Jahre alt und angehender Schauspieler aus dem Ruhrgebiet. Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach Regisseuren und Filmschaffenden in NRW, mit denen ich spannende Kurzfilmprojekte realisieren kann.

Ich habe bereits in drei Kurzfilmen mitgespielt und bin immer auf der Suche nach neuen Möglichkeiten, vor der Kamera zu arbeiten und gemeinsam kreative Projekte umzusetzen.

Ich habe außerdem etwas zu Kurzfilmfestivals recherchiert und bin dabei auf die Internationalen Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen und das KFFK „Battle of the Shorts“ gestoßen:

https://www.kurzfilmtage.de/de/festival/einreichung/

https://www.kffk.de/battle-of-the-shorts/

Vielleicht hast du ja selbst schon länger eine Idee für einen Kurzfilm oder hättest Lust, gemeinsam etwas auf die Beine zu stellen. Gerade ein Projekt mit dem Ziel, es anschließend bei passenden Festivals einzureichen, fände ich sehr spannend.

Falls du grundsätzlich Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit hast, würde ich mich sehr über einen Austausch freuen! 🙌

LG

CHAPMAN UNIVERSITY THESIS FILM CASTING CALL

PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — Comedy/Drama

Logline: After getting into serious trouble at school, an international high schooler hires two strangers to pose as his parents for a disciplinary meeting, only for the lie to become increasingly difficult to control.

Shoot Dates: Oct. 2–4 & Oct. 9–11, 2026

Location: Orange County / Chapman University area

Auditions: Self-tape, callbacks if needed

NON-UNION ONLY. SAG-AFTRA / union performers cannot be considered.

JUSTIN — Lead, Male, 18, East Asian. Rebellious and emotionally guarded, Justin uses sarcasm and makes impulsive decisions to avoid facing the consequences of his actions. Beneath his detached attitude lies a deep fear of disappointing his family and of being forced to admit he is struggling. Seeking strong deadpan comedic timing and subtle dramatic range. Pay: $150/day, est. 6 days / $900 total.

PRINCIPAL ANDERSON — Supporting, Male, 40-60, any ethnicity. A stern and intimidating school administrator with very dry humor. Seeking strong authority and understated comedic timing. Pay: $150/day, est. 4 days / $600 total.

MIA — Supporting, Female, 40s, any ethnicity. Glamorous, confident, unpredictable stranger hired to pose as Justin’s mother. Strong comedic timing and expressive screen presence. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

TOM — Supporting, Male, 40s, any ethnicity. Rough, awkward Uber driver hired to pose as Justin’s father. Seeking natural deadpan comedy with warmth underneath. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

RYAN — Supporting, Male, 20s, any ethnicity. Justin’s social, easygoing, casually chaotic roommate and friend. Natural comedic timing and relaxed charisma. Unpaid; meals, copy, and credit provided.

AI NOTICE: This production will use AI-generated and/or AI-assisted visual elements during post-production/VFX. Additional details will be provided to selected performers before signing.

TO SUBMIT: Email zmao@chapman.edu with subject “PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — [ROLE] — [NAME]” and include headshot, résumé, reel if available, current location, availability for the shoot dates, and confirmation that you are non-union.

🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

• Headshot
• Showreel / previous acting work (if available)

• Location
• Availability in September

I’ll send Emily’s dialogue / casting tape material to anyone interested in auditioning.

CASTING CALL:
Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short film. 

Self-tapes will be available; keep an eye out for the next post!

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.

Dzięki uprzejmości na <3 narejsy.pl <3 wylicytowałem na aukcji charytatywnej prywatny rejs na wraz ze skipperem. 
Tu oczywiście pragnę podziękować za super inicjatywę.
Dumałem, dumałem... i wpadłem na pomysł aby pstryknąć przy okazji kilka zdjęć.  Do dyspozycji mamy jacht Platinum 40 Prestige 

Jadzie ze mną dziewczyna oraz bratową - prawdopodobnie ruszamy w piątek 18stego (ok. 18 z Warszawy). 

Isnieje możliwość transportu do Gdańska, a także możliwość noclegu z piątku na sobotę oraz (albo) z soboty na niedzielę [odpowiednio cały koszt dojazdu+apartamentu dzielony solidarnie na osobę]. 
Powrót w niedzielę orczywiście również możliwy.
Wybieramy taki apartament - aby każdy miał gdzie spać.

Zarówno w sobotę - wieczorem po sesji, jak i całą niedzielę chcemy pozwiedzać okolice - muzea, zabytki, zjeść coś dobrego.
Możesz się przyłączyć , możemy jeszcze zrobić kilka zdjęć - ale to jest opcja. Ty decydujesz.

Niestety NIE zapewniam w tym wypadku wizażu, ale masz okazję na fantastyczny weekend i wyknanie nietuzinkowych fotek.

NIE oczekuję żadnego podziękowania/zapłaty za zdjęcia, ale będzie mi bardzo miło za symboliczny przelew na fundację.

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 37/2026

HEXENTIME, ORIGIN STORY UND 20 JAHRE LIGHTNING MC QUEEN 

Die Owens-Schwestern ﻿﻿Sally (Sandra Bullock) und Gillian (Nicole Kidman) müssen sich dem dunklen Fluch stellen, der ihre Familie ein für alle Mal zu vernichten droht. Ob Practical Magic 2 fast 30 Jahre nach dem Erstling verzaubert, erzählt Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

The Uprising – Für die Freiheit“ ist ein kommender historischer Action-Thriller von Regisseur Paul Greengrass, der den Kinos startet. Der Film dramatisiert den englischen Bauernaufstand (Peasants’ Revolt) von 1381 gegen die Tyrannei von König Richard II.. Der Film dient insgeheim als eine Art Origin-Story für die legendäre Figur Robin Hood. Ob es tatsächlich einer weiteren Variante dieses Themas bedarf, erfahren Sie in unserer Sendung.

La tre Vita - Die drei Leben nennt sich der neueste Kurzfilm vom Pulkautaler Filmemacher Benjamin Baumgartner.  Wie der Film entstanden ist, worauf er basiert usw. erzählte er unserer Moderatorin im Gespräch. Ebenso durften wir mit Leonhard Pill anlässlich seiner neuesten Doku MUSS DAS PFERD AUCH ARBEITEN ein Interview führen.

Anlässlich des 20jährigen Anniversary von CARS bringen wir Auszüge aus dem Soundtrack aus 2006.

Mittwoch 9.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

items.text:
** Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

items.text:
Für einen sehr kleinen, humorvollen Werbefilm suchen wir noch **Nachwuchs- oder Laienschauspieler:innen/ spannende Persönlichkeiten** im Alter von 35 - 50 Jahren.

Schauspielerfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber keinesfalls notwendig. Viel wichtiger sind uns interessante Persönlichkeiten mit einer starken Ausstrahlung, die Interesse und Lust auf Film und/ oder neuen Herausforderungen haben.

**Drehort: Nürnberg **

**Drehtag: 09.10.26 oder 11.10.26.**

Da es sich um ein sehr kleines Projekt handelt, kann die Produktion leider nur eine **Aufwandsentschädigung von bis zu 300,- für den Drehtag **anbieten, ohne Reisekosten.

Wenn ihr euch angesprochen fühlt, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit einem Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch an folgende E-Mail: thaikevinpilz@gmail.com

**CASTING CALL — Do you have a loved one in the UK? **

We're making a short documentary-style film about the food we miss when the people we love are far from home. We're not looking for actors. We're looking for a real family, Black/ Coloured/ Indian. Must be available for shoot dates in Early October

You might be right for this if:
* You have a grown child, sibling or parent living in the **United Kingdom (Including Ireland/ Scottland/ Whales)**
* You know what their life over there actually looks like — the work, the hours, the city
* There's a dish only you make properly, the one they always ask for. Bobotie. Melktert. Koeksisters. Umngqusho. Breyani. Your trifle, the one the family still argues about.
* You'd be comfortable being yourself on camera

**One important thing: this is a surprise.** Please don't mention it to your person in the UK — not a call, not a message, not a hint. If they find out, we can't use the story.

We're casting a South African family of colour (Black, Coloured or Indian). The selected family is professionally remunerated, and everything you send us is treated as confidential.

**Interested?** WhatsApp me a **voicenote or a short video** telling me:
1. Who your person is, and where they are in the UK
2. **What they do over there, and how long they've been there**
3. The dish they miss most — and why only you can make it right

📲 **0834563341 - This must reach me no later than 8 September**

I'll send you the full brief and a short questionnaire from there.

*Please share this with someone it might fit — just not with the person in the UK.*

LOS ANGELES AUDITIONS FOR Norwegian Cruise Line 

Norwegian Cruise Line is seeking VOCALISTS and DANCERS for the all-new productions aboard NCL's newest ship, the Norwegian AURA.

**DANCERS - September 19, 2026**
*Open Call. No pre-registration required. Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive.*

**Sign-In: **9:30am
**Start:** 10:00am

**LOCATION**
Mihran K. Studios
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502 

Female-identifying performers, please be prepared to dance in both heels and flats. Male-identifying dancers should bring sneakers and jazz shoes. Bring a hard copy of your headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combos. Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.

**SPECIALTY VOCALISTS & PRODUCTION SINGERS - September 20, 2026**
****By Appointment Only****

To be considered for an appointment, please have your representation submit via Breakdown Services, submit yourself via Actors Access or submit via **vocalists.castingcrane.com**

Selected applicants will receive an email with audition location, audition time, and additional audition details.

**CONTRACT DETAILS:**
Creative Team: Kevin & Marcel Wilson
Rehearsals begin on or about November 9, 2026 for Dancers
Holiday Break: December 20, 2026 – January 10, 2027
Rehearsal Resumes: January 11, 2027 For Dancers
Rehearsals begin on or about January 11, 2027 for Specialty Vocalists
Rehearsals begin on or about February 8, 2027 for Singers
Board the Norwegian AURA on or about February 22, 2027
End of contract TBD 6-7 months onboard
Itinerary: Mediterranean and Caribbean
***All dates subject to change.***

SPECIALTY VOCALISTS: $1,730/week ($7,500/month) onboard
SINGERS: $1,200/week ($5,200/month) onboard
DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard  

Travel will be provided to Tampa for rehearsal, to the ship, and home at the end of the contract. Cast members will be provided with a single occupancy cabin onboard (including dancers). Cast will be Crew Members with no cruise staff duties outside of the performance schedule. 

Please visit the link below for more information:

[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

Udział w konkursie to kolejna możliwość zdobycia nowego dyplomu do portfolio, cennego doświadczenia, motywacji do dalszego rozwoju oraz pięknych artystycznych wspomnień. ❤️

Actors!

It's that time again:) 

My question is, what if everything got easier by being more of who you are? This year, how about not trying to get everything right, and lead with hope/have more fun instead!

Everything starts with a free 20 minute consult. Head to [https://www.gabriellevey.com/grad-school-auditions](https://www.gabriellevey.com/grad-school-auditions) for more information and contact info.

sharedPost.text:
NOW ACCEPTING NEW CLIENTS FOR BFA/MFA AUDITION COACHING
 
Head to www.gabriellevey.com learn more/book your first session!

Auditioning for BFA/MFA programs can be one of the more stressful days in a young actor’s life. It can also be one of the most incredibly satisfying, impactful, and exhilarating! I work with my clients to help them shine in ways that feel singularly authentic, while staying open to any and all possibilities that arise moment to moment.

Who it’s for:
My ideal clients are curious and playful, motivated and courageous. If you’re open to the creative process and ready to step outside your comfort zone, let’s work together to build the skills that will help you feel your best, share your full self, and ace auditions.

How it works:
For BFA and MFA programs, you’re not auditioning for a role, you’re auditioning for a spot in a dynamic ensemble of actors who will be training together for 2 to 4 years. The most important thing is for the jurors to see YOU and everything that you, and only you can bring to the room. And we see the most of you when you are unabashedly having fun and playing with abandon. For this reason it is critical that we find material that you LOVE and will be thrilled to share on the day of the audition.

I help clients:
•choose audition materials that light you up
•rehearse those materials to draw out and physicalize a character’s nuanced traits and motivations
•find and cultivate the fun in your work and the pleasure of performance in a high pressure environment

Successful outcomes:
As a graduate of Boston University and the David Geffen School of Drama at Yale, I have first hand experience with successful BFA and MFA auditions. And, after years of coaching I have developed a unique process built for success. In addition to a wide range of BFA/MFA programs in the US, I understand the British BFA/MFA circuit particularly well.
 
My clients have landed spots at:
•David Geffen School of Drama at Yale
•Juilliard
•NYU
•Brown/Trinity Rep
•Columbia
•UCSD
•RADA (UK)
•Guildhall (UK)
•LAMDA (UK)
•Central School of Speech and Drama (UK)
•Many, many more

⚙️ SEGURIDAD, ENSAMBLAJE Y TRANSPORTE DE UNA BÁSCULA ACROBÁTICA

Una báscula acrobática no recibe siempre el impacto de manera perfectamente sincronizada.

Durante un ejercicio puede producirse un destiempo: uno de los portores llega antes que el otro, el saltador demora la caída o el volante que debía salir permanece por un instante sobre la tabla. En ese momento, la fuerza deja de distribuirse uniformemente y la báscula recibe una carga desigual.

La repetición de estos impactos genera un enorme estrés sobre la madera, las placas, los herrajes y los sistemas de fijación. Los listones pueden comenzar a desplazarse, la tabla puede torcerse y los tornillos pueden aflojarse, partirse o incluso salir despedidos por la presión acumulada.

Por eso, la seguridad de una báscula no depende únicamente de la calidad de la madera. También depende de cómo se mantienen unidos sus listones y de la capacidad del sistema para soportar la tensión, la flexión y la recuperación producidas durante cada salto.

Existen diferentes métodos para evitar que las tablas se desplacen.

Algunas personas entizan completamente la báscula con cuerda para mantener todos los listones unidos. Otras combinan el entizado con resina epóxica, convirtiendo las distintas piezas en una sola unidad. También existen básculas recubiertas con material microporoso y selladas completamente.

Estos sistemas pueden aumentar la cohesión del conjunto, pero también presentan una dificultad importante: la báscula se convierte en una pieza fija, voluminosa y prácticamente imposible de desarmar.

Esto complica considerablemente su transporte.

Una báscula completa, con su estructura de madera, caballete, placas, pernos, herrajes, sistemas de amarre y cojines, no es un aparato ligero. Su estructura metálica necesita peso, rigidez y estabilidad para permanecer firme durante los impactos. No puede fabricarse con la ligereza de una barra rusa u otro aparato portátil, porque cumple una función mecánica completamente diferente.

Por esa razón, las básculas generalmente permanecen dentro de una compañía, una escuela o un circo. Cuando los acróbatas deben trabajar en otro continente, muchas veces resulta más práctico fabricar otra báscula en el lugar de destino que intentar transportar el aparato completo en un avión.

Una báscula construida como una sola pieza difícilmente puede convertirse en equipaje aéreo. Para trasladarla habría que enviarla como carga especial o por vía marítima, asumiendo costos de embalaje, transporte, almacenamiento, trámites aduaneros e impuestos.

Por eso estamos estudiando y desarrollando una alternativa más práctica: preparar la báscula mediante un sistema que permita desarmar, ordenar y embalar sus componentes de manera segura para facilitar su traslado y posterior ensamblaje.

Sin embargo, incluso una báscula desmontable conserva elementos pesados. El caballete y los herrajes deben soportar grandes cargas y no pueden reducirse de peso sin considerar primero la estabilidad y la seguridad del aparato.

Para pedidos internacionales, una alternativa conveniente puede ser fabricar en el Perú la madera especializada y enviarla preparada para que el cliente construya el caballete y los herrajes en su propio país, siguiendo las dimensiones y especificaciones correspondientes. Esto reduce considerablemente el volumen y el peso del envío, además de evitar una parte importante de los costos de transporte y aduana.

También podemos evaluar la fabricación y el envío del aparato completo cuando el cliente lo requiera. Aunque el traslado representa una inversión mayor, una báscula correctamente fabricada, utilizada dentro de sus especificaciones, inspeccionada periódicamente y sometida al mantenimiento necesario puede prestar servicio durante muchos años.

Un aparato profesional puede permanecer 10, 15 o hasta 20 años dentro de una compañía e incluso pasar de una generación de artistas a otra. Durante todo ese tiempo continúa formando acróbatas, produciendo números y generando ingresos.

Por eso, la inversión en una buena báscula no debe medirse únicamente por su costo inicial. Debe evaluarse por su seguridad, su rendimiento, su vida útil y la cantidad de trabajo que puede producir a lo largo de los años.

Una báscula no es simplemente una tabla sobre un caballete.

Es un sistema completo en el que la madera, los herrajes, las fijaciones, los cojines, el peso, las dimensiones y la experiencia del fabricante deben trabajar conjuntamente.

MUNDO CIRCENSE SXE

Fabricación especializada de aparatos y accesorios para artistas de circo.

Experiencia, conocimiento técnico y seguridad al servicio del espectáculo.

🎪 CASTING CALL: Kids Variety & Circus Performers (1-Year Contract in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia) 🇸🇦

We are hiring dynamic, charismatic variety and circus performers for daily performances and interactive stage shows at our premier kids’ amusement centers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

If you love performing for children, have strong crowd-engagement skills, and are ready for an exciting international placement, we want to hear from you!

🎭 Profiles We Are Looking For:

 Magicians / Illusionists: Fast-paced, high-energy stage and close-up comedy magic tailored for children and families.

 Jugglers & Unicycle Acts: Solo jugglers, unicycle jugglers, stilt walkers, and contact juggling.

 Circus & Novelty Artists: Bubble artists, balancing acts, physical comedy / clowning, and multi-skilled variety performers.

(Multi-skilled artists who can combine skills—e.g., magic + balloon modeling or juggling + unicycle—are highly preferred!)

💼 What We Provide:

 Contract Duration: 1-Year full-time contract (renewable).

 Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

 Competitive Tax-Free Monthly Salary (based on experience and act specialty).

 Company Accommodation provided.

 Daily Transportation to and from the venue.

 Round-trip Flight Tickets (origin to Riyadh and return).

 Visa can be discussed.

📋 Candidate Requirements:

 Proven experience performing for children/family audiences.

 High energy, engaging stage presence, and interactive performance style.

 Own costume(s) and performance props suitable for family-friendly environments.

 Valid passport (minimum 18 months validity).

 Available to relocate to Riyadh.

📩 How to Apply:

Please send a direct message (Inbox) or email to ract.consulting@gmail.com with:

1. Promo Video / Unedited Showreel Link (YouTube, Vimeo, or Drive link showing acts performed in front of an audience).

2. Current CV / Performance Resume.

3. 3–4 high-resolution stage photos / costume photos.

4. Current location & availability date.

Shortlisted performers will be contacted directly for an online interview.

Na plan serialu fabularnego KB szukam statystów na dni poniżej. Tym razem przenosimy się na przejście graniczne z Ukrainą. Magia kina – gramy w Warszawie.

** **

Tutaj czwartek 17.09 jest rezerwą. Gdyby była zmiana na 17.09, będę pytać o dostępność smsem. Gramy parking na przejściu granicznym. Plan w Centrum Targowo-Kongresowym EXPO.

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **szukam różnych aut na parking z wyłączeniem białych. Stawka **180 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

- **PODRÓŻNI / PASAŻEROWIE AUTOKARU** -  kobiety i mężczyźni w różnym wieku. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**.

- **MUNDUROWI I CYWILE **– kobiety i mężczyźni do 55 lat.

Stawka  **170 zł gotówką** – **osoby kontynuacyjne na 2 dni**, wskazane przez reżysera. Łącznie **340 zł za 2 dni **płatne 22 września gotówką.

** **

items.text:
hey all, anyone have any advice on how to get into the scene with pretty nonexistent production background experience, but a film education/BFA?

having a hard time getting anyone to give me the time of day since I've been out of the film world for so long. I'm very willing to do even unpaid work but it seems like because I had to go to corporate for ten years, people look at my resume and turn me away even though those skills are very easily transferrable. 

I have worked on a couple indie sets, but back in '17. i'm trying to finally get out of corporate and i moved out to LA thinking it'd be easier get on even just a small set, but it's been months and no one has given me even the smallest of shots, i don't even know how many PA roles I've applied to now.

Any tips?

topComments.text: Agreed with Bennetts question. I often see some people I’ve hired as background working as costume, PAs, Production Coordinators etc on subsequent shows for other shows that the same company produces

sharedPost.text:
🌀🎬🎥🌚 Exclusive Acting Workshop – Final Version .version A.

💡 Value Highlight: Learn directly from a DP/Director whose professional rate is $1,500/day 

this 4-session online workshop gives you real film-level expertise at a fraction of that cost!
Price on enquiry.

VERY LOW COST: One-on-One Online via Skype
"This course integrates the poetic realism of Tarkovsky, the practical wisdom of Michael Caine, and the transformative techniques of Stanislavski and Method Acting. Designed to deepen your craft, it focuses on authentic emotional connection and powerful storytelling."

🎬 Created by a British Cinematographer/Director with 31 Years of Experience and 32 Features to His Name
🌐 International Experience: Having worked on films worldwide, collaborating with actors and directors, I bring real-world insights from both sides of the camera. This course is designed to give actors a deep understanding of their craft, emphasizing emotional depth and character development.

🌐 IMDb: www.imdb.com/name/nm1806508

🌐 Showreel: https://enkiproductions1.8b.io

🤔 What You Will Learn:

🌀 Emotional Range: Master the ability to express a full spectrum of emotions, making your performances more believable and compelling.

🌀 Character Development: Create rich, multidimensional characters by exploring their internal world, external actions, and backstory.

🌀 Method Acting: Use personal experiences and emotions to deliver raw, authentic performances.

🌀 Working with Directors and Crew: Learn how to hit marks, understand shooting ratios, and collaborate with crew members to enhance your performance.

🌀 Scene Preparation: Techniques for script interpretation, emotional connection, and performing under pressure.

🌀 Industry Standards: How to create a professional showreel and work effectively with casting directors and filmmakers.
🎬 Day 1: Moment-to-Moment Acting (Stanislavski’s Approach).

🔹 Breaking a Scene Down: The use of internal visualization and meditation to "become" the character.

Character Exercise: The Hitman’s First Kill
📍 Scene: A low-rent hotel room in Manhattan, lit by a dull winter’s midday light. The sad hum of a ceiling fan, distant sirens, muted traffic below. On the bed—a brand-new sniper rifle.

🔹 Exercise 1 (Singular Emotion): Enter the room, pick up the gun, examine it, and prepare for the target. Remain fully in character.

🔹 Exercise 2 (Multiple Emotional Shifts):
Enter slightly out of breath, feeling relief—"I made it here. No one saw me."
The weight of reality sets in—"Am I really about to kill someone?"
Mesmerized by the artistry of the gun—draw on memories of seeing/touching weapons.
Snapped back to reality by a siren—trace the feeling of waking from a dream.
Decision made—move to the window, set up the gun, and wait.

🔹 Discussion: How do actors like Heath Ledger, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Dustin Hoffman make their characters so real? Insights from my own experiences on set with actors who never broke character—even during dinner.

Exercise 3 (If Time Allows): The Phone Call
📍 Scene: You’ve done something terrible—enough to make the person you love most leave forever. You must convince them to stay.

🎭 Goal: Improvise, using pure emotional truth, until the performance is undeniably real.

🎬 Day 2: Making Your Character Believable
🔹 Understanding the Psyche: Whether playing a killer or an ordinary person, you must know your character’s mind.

Character Exercise: The Breaking Point
📍 Scene: A crowded supermarket. A tired voice announces deals over the PA. You feel unseen, unheard, frustrated—until suddenly, you’re holding an AK-47. (Note: These scenes are purely acting exercises. They can be altered if a student is uncomfortable.)

🔹 Alternative Scene: A character about to detonate a bomb, written in the style of Heath Ledger’s Joker.

🔹 Alternative Scene: A video call to the person you love most—telling them why. (Scripted or improv.)

📍 Final Monologue Exercise: "Hi everyone… Tomorrow’s going to be different." The last words before an irreversible decision

🔹 Accents: Versatility in performance—working with British, American (Deep South), and Northern Irish accents.

🔹 Final Exercise: The Power of Stillness—sit before the camera, smiling, at total peace. Convey pure serenity.

🎬 Day 3: Working with a Director and Crew
🔹 Understanding Your Role: How an actor fits into the filmmaking process.

🔹 Hitting Marks & Lighting: The technical side of making performances shine.

🔹 Shooting Ratios: How they affect your performance.

🔹 Crew Collaboration: Understanding continuity, sound, makeup, cinematography, and direction.
Final Showreel Scenes (Day 3):

🎭 Sinister: "So you really think you got away with it? You really think that?" (Improv)

🎭 Heartbroken: "But I didn’t mean it... please, please, don’t leave me…" (Improv)

🎭 Insane (Joker-like): "Mmm... if E = mc², then time versus chaos... who cares?" (Improv)

🎭 Flat & Emotionless: "We’re born, we live, we die. That’s it." (Improv)
🔹 Goal: Draw from personal experiences and trace memories to make the performances deeply real.

🎬 Day 4: Fear and Survival – Personal Experience & Character Creation

🔹 Deep Dive: Exploring fear, survival, and desperation in character work.

Exercise 1: The Jungle Escape
📍 Scene: You’re lost in the jungle at night, exhausted, your breath the only sound. Every step is agony, but stopping means death. You call out—pleading for help. No answer.

🎭 Emotions to Explore:
Fear of death – the realization that no one is coming.
Desperation – the raw instinct to survive.
Physical exhaustion – feeling your body give in.

🎭 Method Process:
Internal Visualization – Close your eyes, hear the insects, the rustling leaves, your pounding heartbeat.

Personal Connection – Recall a moment when you felt completely lost or afraid.
Scene Execution – Let the emotions guide your body and voice.

Exercise 2: The Phone Call Redux
📍 Scene: You’re on the phone with a loved one. You need their help. If they refuse, it’s over. What do you say? What do you leave out?

🎭 Objective: Make the desperation feel real. This is life or death.

Final Performance (Day 4):
Students will perform a final emotional scene, bringing together everything they’ve learned. These performances will be recorded as raw material for their showreel.

🎬🎥 Ready to Elevate Your Acting?
This isn’t just a class—it’s an intense, immersive experience that will change the way you act forever.

🌐 To Enroll: p.m.me or e.mail:
mikeenkiproductions1@gmail.com
Let’s create something unforgettable.

**Title: Grandma's Back**

**Genre: ***Comedy, Family Drama*

**Logline: **Susannah must keep herself and her family together when the sudden reanimation of her late mother throws their lives into chaos.

**Roles:**

**Susannah **- *LEAD - Female, 35-55*

Loving and neurotic mother of two recently grieving the death of her own mother. Constantly striving towards success and stability. Despite her best efforts to do what’s best for her daughter and be the mom she always wanted, her attempts often have the opposite effect, only pushing her daughter further away.

**Tess **- *Lead - Female, 14-22*

The defiant eldest of the family.  Artistic and goth, Tess marches to the beat of her own drum, and holds an inner confidence that is bizzare to Susannah. All she wants is for her mom to recognize her spark, and not control her so tightly.

**Grandma **- *Lead - Female, 60-80*

An old fashioned stern woman, who's decided its her way or the highway. Raising Susannah on strict morales, she's left a lasting impact on the generations of her family.

**Greg** - *Supporting - Male, 35-55*

Despite him being quite useless, he is the emotional anchor of the family. Although he may not know exactly what's going on, or what to say, he will always know how to comfort the ones he loves.

**Steven** - *Supporting - Male, 5-12*

The youngest of the family. He is a bothersome little brother and a lovable son. His pastimes consist mainly of irritating his big sister Tess and living in crippling fear of vampires.

**Young Susannah** - *Supporting - Female, 5-12*

Susannah as a child. Very small role. 

**Young Grandma** - *Supporting - Female, 35-55*

Grandma as a young mother. Very small role. 

**Scholarship Committee Members** - *Supporting - All Genders, 35-70*

Unamused and stone faced. The only thing standing between Tess and her Scholarship. Not a speaking role. 

**Art Gallery Extras** - *All Genders, 15-70*

attendees of the gallery

**Director**: Sophii Sherman, Christine Galvez

**Producer: **Dominic Spacone

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: Daspacone@gmail.com

**Run Time**: 10-12 minutes

**Compensation**: Unpaid - Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner provided

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information - **

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS:** We will reach out with further information

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: Email with interest and I will send you sides to audition with - Daspacone@gmail.com

**Shooting Schedule**: September 26th, October 24th,25th, November 6-8th

**Filming Location**: Boulder/Denver area

**Note: **Not all actors needed all days

**Tess **- *Lead - Female, 14-22*

The defiant eldest of the family.  Artistic and goth, Tess marches to the beat of her own drum, and holds an inner confidence that is bizzare to Susannah. All she wants is for her mom to recognize her spark, and not control her so tightly.

**Grandma **- *Lead - Female, 60-80*

An old fashioned stern woman, who's decided its her way or the highway. Raising Susannah on strict morales, she's left a lasting impact on the generations of her family.

**Greg** - *Supporting - Male, 35-55*

Despite him being quite useless, he is the emotional anchor of the family. Although he may not know exactly what's going on, or what to say, he will always know how to comfort the ones he loves.

**Steven** - *Supporting - Male, 5-12*

The youngest of the family. He is a bothersome little brother and a lovable son. His pastimes consist mainly of irritating his big sister Tess and living in crippling fear of vampires.

**Young Susannah** - *Supporting - Female, 5-12*

Susannah as a child. Very small role. 

**Young Grandma** - *Supporting - Female, 35-55*

Grandma as a young mother. Very small role. 

**Scholarship Committee Members** - *Supporting - All Genders, 35-70*

Unamused and stone faced. The only thing standing between Tess and her Scholarship. Not a speaking role. 

**Art Gallery Extras** - *All Genders, 15-70*

attendees of the gallery
